blocks.html: For property teams, the gap between a warm enquiry and a booked site visit is where most deals quietly disappear. A plain text alert rarely closes that gap. RCS Messaging for Real Estate changes the moment entirely — it turns an ordinary SMS thread into a branded, media-rich conversation where a buyer can scroll a property carousel, open a brochure and tap to book a visit without ever leaving the default messaging app on their phone. This guide walks through how rich messaging works for property marketing, what it costs in INR, where it fits across the buyer journey, and what to check before you pick a messaging partner. Already comparing channels? Explore Ojiva AI's WhatsApp Business API, pair it with SMS, or book a free demo to see it running on your live listings.

sections.heading: How Rich Messaging Works for Property Marketing

blocks.html: Rich Communication Services — the global standard maintained by the GSMA — upgrades a basic text thread into a two-way, app-like conversation. For a builder or broker, that means property listings, videos and booking buttons arrive right inside the buyer's default messages app, with no new download and no extra step to lose the lead along the way.

items.desc: buyers see your property alerts inside the phone's default SMS app — nothing new to install.

items.title: Verified builder branding:
items.desc: your project name, logo and brand colour show up instead of an unknown number, so buyers trust the message.

items.title: Property carousels and rich cards:
items.desc: photos, walkthrough videos and swipeable unit catalogues sit directly in the thread.

items.title: Tap-to-book quick actions:
items.desc: buyers reply, request a brochure or book a site visit with a single tap instead of typing.

sections.heading: Staying DLT & TRAI Compliant on Property Campaigns

blocks.html: Google's agent verification confirms your builder identity, but it doesn't replace India's existing SMS compliance framework — most property campaigns still fall back to SMS for unsupported devices, and that fallback layer stays governed by TRAI's Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) rules.

items.title: DLT-registered sender IDs:
items.desc: your builder identity and message templates stay registered and traceable, in line with TRAI's framework.

items.title: Template-level compliance:
items.desc: promotional launch blasts and transactional payment reminders are checked against DLT categories before they go out.

items.title: Two layers, not one:
items.desc: Google verification and DLT registration run alongside each other, covering both the rich and the SMS fallback layer.

items.title: Audit-ready records:
items.desc: delivery and consent logs are kept for every registered sender ID, so buyer outreach stays accountable.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About RCS Messaging for Real Estate

items.q: How does rich messaging help a real estate business get more site visits?
items.a: Instead of a plain text alert, buyers receive a property carousel with photos, pricing and a tap-to-book button right inside their messages app. Booking a visit takes one tap with no call-back, so more warm enquiries turn into confirmed site visits. Book a free demo to see it on your own listings.

items.q: Can I send property photos, videos and brochures through these messages?
items.a: Yes. Rich cards and carousels carry high-quality images, walkthrough videos and PDF brochures directly in the thread, so buyers view everything about a project without opening a separate app or attachment.

items.q: How much does RCS messaging cost for a real estate business in India?
items.a: Pricing typically combines a platform or API subscription with a per-message fee for property cards and carousels, plus SMS fallback charged separately when a device doesn't support rich messages. Ojiva AI shares an actual INR rate card once your listing volume and template mix are known.

items.q: Do property messaging campaigns need DLT registration?
items.a: Yes, if your campaigns include an SMS fallback — which most do, since rich messages don't yet reach every device. Keeping SMS sender IDs and templates DLT-registered ensures fallback alerts still deliver compliantly under TRAI's framework.

items.q: Can this integrate with my existing real estate CRM?
items.a: Yes — a single messaging API sends delivery, read and reply events as webhooks that your CRM or lead desk can consume like any other channel, keeping every buyer conversation logged next to the lead record instead of in a separate tool.

items.q: What's the difference between RCS and SMS for property marketing?
items.a: SMS is limited to plain text from an unbranded number. Rich messaging adds a verified builder name and logo, property carousels, videos and one-tap booking buttons — while still falling back to SMS automatically for buyers on unsupported devices.

items.q: How do buyers book a site visit inside the message?
items.a: Quick-reply buttons let a buyer pick a date and time slot directly in the thread. The booking flows back to your team through the CRM integration, so a site visit is confirmed without a single phone call.
